name: Avatar of Phantoms
description:
• Your insomnia no longer spawns Phantoms. Sleepless night add a Phantom to your [blue]Phantom Horde[/blue], up to 10.

  • While gliding, you [brown]bite[/brown] enemies you collide with for [effect:phantomhorde][dark-gray]3-5❤️[/dark-gray][/effect]

effects.explanation: Scales with Phantom Horde size, capped after 5 days. This base damage scales from 0.65x - 1.35x based on velocity.
